entities.name: Naga
entities.description: Humanoid snake-like species with serpentine lower bodies; an obsolete creature type found on Tarkir, Amonkhet and Ravnica.

entities.name: Sultai Brood
entities.description: Tarkir clan ruled by the naga, who allied with rakshasa for necromantic power.

entities.name: Sidisi
entities.description: Merciless queen of the naga in the original timeline.

entities.name: Rakshasa
entities.description: Beings with whom ancient human leaders made pacts, becoming naga.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: Dragon who enslaved the naga as the result of a pact with Tasigur.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: City on Amonkhet where naga live.

entities.name: Sweetest Harmony
entities.description: Naga principle of perfect balance between body and mind.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: God whom naga believe is interdependent with Rhonas.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: God whom naga believe is interdependent with Kefnet.

events.summary: The Naga creature type is made obsolete with Modern Horizons 3, with all naga errata'd to Snake.
events.quote: The decision was made to obsolete the type and errata all instances of Naga to Snake .

events.summary: In the new timeline, Silumgar forces the naga into slavery as a result of Tasigur's pact; after his overthrow the Sultai revive.
events.quote: Naga were forced into becoming slaves, undead or otherwise, by Silumgar as the result of a pact Tasigur made with the dragon.

relations.quote: led by the merciless Sidisi , queen of the naga
who have made allegiances with Rakshasa to gain incredible necromancy powers
Naga were forced into becoming slaves, undead or otherwise, by Silumgar
On Ravnica , Naga appear as members of the Golgari Swarm .
